BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fiscal note instructions; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that some economicdevelopment initiatives, including tax incentives and infrastructurefinance, have the potential for a positive fiscal impact on the statethat is not always reflected in the fiscal notes prepared by stateagencies. It is the intent of this legislation to adopt a pilotproject to review the feasibility and reliability of fiscal notes thatreflect the potential for increased revenue from economic developmentinitiatives. The office of financial management and the department of revenue,in consultation with the senate and house of representatives, shallperform economic modeling on three examples of economic developmentlegislation enacted during the 2010 legislative session. The office offinancial management and the department of revenue shall monitor theimplementation of the legislation and compare the economic impacts toeconomic modeling. No later than five years after the effective dateof the legislation, the department of revenue and the office of p. 1 SSB 6374financial management shall compare the economic modeling with theactual results of the legislation and shall provide a report to thelegislature comparing the two.
